'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Josh DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Username:''' Renmaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
